games.title: Party Pack
games.tagline: Six phones-as-controllers party games on one big screen: punchlines, bluffing, terrible art, a murder quiz, T-shirt battles and an Imposter's pitch.

roles.name: Main Stage
roles.description: Open on the TV or computer everyone can see. Shows the room code; bots can fill empty seats.

roles.name: Phone controller
roles.description: Join from a phone with the 4-character room code. The first player in is the VIP and picks the game.

roles.name: Audience
roles.description: Watch, vote and fill the Hype Meter. A unanimous audience vote doubles the points.

roles.name: Prompt Studio
roles.description: Write custom prompt packs and get a 7-digit share code.

multiplayer.style: party, host-authoritative, phones as controllers, room code
multiplayer.notes: The Main Stage runs every game and pushes a view to each phone. Up to 8 players plus audience phones (the bundled relay caps a room at 16 connections). Design document: games/party-pack/docs/GDD.md.

requires: a shared screen plus one phone per player
npm start for play across devices

games.title: Sea of Chaos: Arena
games.tagline: A first-person pirate battle royale. Crew one ship together, sink rivals, grab treasure, outrun the storm, dodge the Megalodon.

roles.name: Pirate
roles.description: Host an arena or join with its 4-letter code. Everyone crews the same ship (up to four); AI deckhands fill empty posts.

multiplayer.style: PvPvE battle royale, shared crews of up to 4, host-authoritative
multiplayer.notes: Up to 4 players share one ship; 5 to 8 split into two rival ships. AI pirate ships fill the arena to five vessels. Solo play works offline. 3D models: CC-BY-4.0, credited in How to play and models.js.

requires: internet (three.js and fonts load from CDNs)

games.title: Short Fuse
games.tagline: One of you holds a ticking 3D bomb case. The other holds the only manual. Talk fast.

roles.name: Defuser
roles.description: Turns the case over and works the modules.

roles.name: Expert
roles.description: Reads the defusal manual. Never sees the case.

multiplayer.notes: The Expert can link to the Defuser's case ID to see the live timer, strikes and progress.

requires: internet (three.js and fonts load from CDNs)

games.title: Signal Pair
games.tagline: A two-player co-op starter: one player calls a colour code, the other enters it.

roles.name: Caller
roles.description: Sees the code and reads it out.

roles.name: Operator
roles.description: Has the pads and enters the code.
